sentence: For beige on the lower half, choose tops against the pants' shade to turn a color description into garments you can try together.
en_before: Compare a top with familiar white and brown pieces. Near-white fabric with a slight yellow-brown cast can be described as light or pale beige. For something deeper and closer to brown, brown-leaning beige communicates more clearly than “true beige.”

sentence: Compare garment colors in ordinary light to keep the digital beige reference separate from the surface and reflections of the product.
en_before: Fabric has surface, gloss, folds and its own reflection. Screens also depend on display settings. Sampling one pixel from a listing cannot confirm real garment color, particularly in highlights or shadows.
